title: Bind production qualification to offline pinned shipped-dependency advisory evidence
goal: Bind production qualification in xtask local-release to offline caller-provisioned RustSec advisory database snapshots (revision, origin, tree/content digest, freshness window, policy digest, and cargo-deny binary digest) across the root native normal/build dependency graph without network fetches (landed in a14059f8fc47be8566d00c988c4f757f395a63f6).

reuse.justification: Extended xtask's local-release qualification pipeline with a dedicated offline advisory_evidence module binding caller-provisioned RustSec snapshots and cargo-deny digests into manifest-hashed release receipts.
